The heater now holds its state inside a half-degree band either side of the target, and replaying last night's log gives 2 relay switches instead of 12: on at 04:26 (19.3°C) and off at 04:40 (20.6°C).

The half degree is `HYSTERESIS_C = 0.5`, directly under `TARGET_C` at the top of `greenhouse.py`.

- **Boundary readings:** the heater switches on at exactly 19.5°C and off at exactly 20.5°C, so reaching the threshold counts.
- **Startup:** the relay starts off, so if the first reading is inside the band (say 19.8°C) the heater stays off until it drops to 19.5°C.
- **Changed signature:** `heater_on` now takes the current relay state as a second argument. If the controller on the Pi has its own copy of this function or calls it directly, that call needs the same change — I only had this replay script to work with.
